units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 47a:4">B. Bath. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>אי לאו דאודי … לש׳</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>לשחרן</he>, read: <he>לשחון</he>; Alf. ed. Const. <he>לשַׁהֲוָאן</he>) if he had not confessed to him (that he had given him the ass as a present), he would have surrendered him and his ass to the captain (for confiscation).

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 6:4">Sifré Deut. 6</cite> (prov.) <he>עבד … הדבק לש׳ וישתחוו לך</he> a king’s servant is a king, attach thyself to the captain, and they will bow down before thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 801:6">Yalk. ib. 801</cite> <he>הדבק לש׳ וישחון לך</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>הדבק לש׳</he> ‘Rashi’ (ed. <he>לשיחין</he>, <he>לשיחן</he>, <he>לשיחון</he>; Ar. <he>דבוק לשחון</he>).
